_meta.description: Forward-testing template (docs/handoff/backtest/design.md §8): questions asked today that resolve 2-12 weeks later, each settled by a named official series or Polymarket market so the resolution monitor (RESOLUTION_MONITOR_AUTORUN_HOURS) resolves the pipeline's binary forecast without a human. Copy this file, replace the example entries with real questions (drop "example"), check it with `python backend/scripts/backtest_eval.py forward-check --questions <file>`, start one live pipeline per question with the printed prompt, and score the resolved forecasts with `backtest_eval.py forward-score`.

fields.question: one yes/no question
fields.resolution_criteria: the exact settle test (series ID or market, comparator, threshold, period)
fields.resolution_source: {kind: official_data, series, observation (YYYY-MM / YYYY-Qn / YYYY / YYYY-MM-DD), comparator (> >= < <=), threshold, units} or {kind: polymarket, market_id}
fields.resolution_date: YYYY-MM-DD by which the source settles it; 14-84 days after asked_on
fields.example: true marks a template entry; forward-check skips it unless --include-examples

questions.question: Will the US unemployment rate for November 2026 be at least 4.5%?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if fred:UNRATE (Percent, seasonally adjusted) for 2026-11, as first published, is >= 4.5.

questions.question: REPLACE with the market's own yes/no question
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Polymarket market named below resolves Yes.
